run_metadata_to_text: run metadata_to_text.py to convert numeric audio metadata columns into descriptive text bins on HuggingFace datasets
run_bins_to_text: run bins_to_text to compute numeric bins from a dataset column and map each value to a descriptive text label
run_speaker_level_relative_to_gender: run speaker_level_relative_to_gender to compute gender-relative pitch bins on a per-speaker basis
run_visualize_bins_to_text: run visualize_bins_to_text to generate histogram plots showing value distributions with bin edge markers
run_metadata_to_text_squim: run metadata_to_text.py with --apply_squim_quality_estimation to add SI-SDR and PESQ quality bins
